title: Headings Added to Matching Lists

illustrates.quote: 10.9.2 Matching Wide Columns b. Treat column headings that precede each list as cell-5 headings. When there are no print headings, insert a heading, enclosed in transcriber’s note indicators, using terms suggested in the directions.

blocks.text: Who did what? Before each name below, write the letter of the statement you associate with that person.

items.text: was the first man to sail to the tip of Africa from Europe
was the first man to find a sea route to India
was an Italian who made great discoveries for Spain
set up a school for the study of navigation and geography
